message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate criminal charges based on facts. The case: burglary (entering a shop by cutting steel plate, breaking glass) and theft of mobile phones and cigarettes, plus selling some items. Also involved is selling stolen goods. The value: total stolen 2845 RMB, plus sale got 300 RMB. The act is theft (robbery? Not violent against person, but property). It's a burglary (illegal entry with intent to commit theft). In Chinese criminal law, "入室盗窃" (burglary) is a form of theft. The charge likely is "盗窃" (theft). Also "非法侵入住宅或其他场所" maybe "入室盗窃罪". The sale of stolen goods could be "非法买卖赃物" (selling stolen property). However typical charge: "盗窃罪" and "非法买卖赃物罪". But examples: they often list multiple charges separated by semicolon. In similar examples, they used "盗窃;掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". For case where stolen items were sold, they used "盗窃;掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". So we should include both theft and concealment of stolen property. The facts: He stole and sold some items. So charges: 盗窃;掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益. Also maybe "入室盗窃" but they use generic "盗窃". So final answer: [罪名]盗窃;掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益<eoa>
